panel.name: start_panel
panel.text: 1. Choose a WolfAvatar. 2. Say what it says to visitors, or give it a personality. 3. Rez: it appears 2 m in front of you.

button.label: Use my avatar
button.name: use_mine_btn
button.tool_tip: Choose one of the WolfAvatars you have made

button.label: Create a new one
button.name: create_new_btn
button.tool_tip: Make a new character in WolfAvatars; it comes back here to be rezzed

button.label: Make a pet
button.name: make_pet_btn
button.tool_tip: One of your animals as your pet: wear it and it walks beside you everywhere. Free.

panel.text: Create a new one opens WolfAvatars (it shows the price first); when it is made it comes back here. A pet follows you about, and goes home when you log out. Nothing here needs Game Mode.

button.label: Open WolfAvatars
button.name: open_avatars
button.tool_tip: Make a new character in WolfAvatars

panel.name: quick_panel

button.label: Change
button.name: chosen_change
button.tool_tip: Choose another WolfAvatar

line_editor.name: quick_name
line_editor.tool_tip: Shown in chat and in the list (1 to 48 characters).

panel.text: What does it say to visitors?

check_box.name: quick_travel
check_box.label: Follow me everywhere (across the grid)
check_box.tool_tip: It goes with you when you teleport or cross into another region, and to your home when you log out. One travelling pet per person.

panel.text: It follows you at about 2.5 m, sits when you sit and makes animal noises (free). Off: it stays round where you rez it.

radio_group.name: pet_how
radio_group.tool_tip: Wear it: an object you wear, so it goes everywhere you go. Let it roam: an NPC on this region that follows you about here.

radio_item.label: Wear it (it goes everywhere with you)
radio_item.name: wear

panel.name: wear_panel

combo_box.name: wear_side
combo_box.tool_tip: Where it walks: beside your left, beside your right, or behind you. You can change it later from its own menu (touch it).

spinner.name: wear_distance
spinner.label: Distance (m)
spinner.tool_tip: How far from you it walks: 1.0 to 1.5 metres

panel.text: It is made as an object in your inventory (Objects > WolfPets). Choose Add to wear it and it walks beside you on every region, through every teleport. Touch it for its menu: sit, noises, volume, position. Free: no Wolf Credits.

line_editor.name: says
line_editor.label: Welcome to my land!
line_editor.tool_tip: Said once a visit to anyone who comes within 8 m. Leave it empty for a quiet one.

panel.text: Said once a visit to anyone who comes within 8 m. Leave it empty for a quiet one.

check_box.name: quick_ai
check_box.label: Or give it a personality - AI talk (uses your Wolf Credits)
check_box.tool_tip: It answers people who talk to it. Every reply is paid from YOUR Wolf Credits, never the speaker's.

text_editor.name: quick_personality
text_editor.tool_tip: Who it is and how it talks, up to 1000 characters, e.g. A grumpy old bartender who loves gossip.

button.label: More options
button.name: more_btn
button.tool_tip: What it does, where it goes, its pack, the game, a vehicle, the voice...

button.label: Rez
button.name: rez_btn
button.tool_tip: It appears 2 m in front of you, facing you

panel.name: list_view

button.label: Edit...
button.name: edit_btn
button.tool_tip: Its settings, animations and reactions

button.label: Pause
button.name: pause_btn
button.tool_tip: Stand still and do nothing until it is resumed

button.label: Call home
button.name: home_btn
button.tool_tip: It walks back to its home

button.label: Make here its home
button.name: here_btn
button.tool_tip: Where it stands now becomes its home

button.label: Stop and stand
button.name: stop_btn
button.tool_tip: It stands still and forgets what it was doing

button.label: Send home
button.name: sendhome_btn
button.tool_tip: A pet goes to its owner's home (its owner, the region's managers or this parcel's owner)

button.label: Delete
button.name: delete_btn
button.tool_tip: Remove it from the region (asks first)

button.label: See my AI costs
button.name: costs_btn
button.tool_tip: Opens your AI costs page on wolf-grid.com

panel.text: For builders: a script inside an NPC can drive it with wolfNPC(command, value), e.g. wolfNPC("SAY", "Hello"), and read it with wolfNPCInfo("STATE"). Reactions also send link_message -7600100.

button.label: Send home
button.name: detail_sendhome
button.tool_tip: It goes to its owner's home

button.label: Park
button.name: park_btn
button.tool_tip: Stop the vehicle where it is

button.label: Leave vehicle
button.name: exit_btn
button.tool_tip: It gets out and walks again

panel.label: Settings
panel.name: dtab_settings
panel.text: Only what you change is sent.

panel.label: Animations
panel.name: dtab_anims
panel.text: Its own animations first, then the standard ones.

button.label: Loop
button.name: anim_loop
button.tool_tip: Keeps playing over its movement until stopped

panel.label: Game Master
panel.name: dtab_gm

button.label: Take control
button.name: gm_take
button.tool_tip: It stops making its own choices and does what you tell it

button.label: Release
button.name: gm_release
button.tool_tip: Give it back its own life

line_editor.name: gm_say
line_editor.label: what it says in local chat

button.label: Walk to where I click
button.name: gm_click
button.tool_tip: Then click the ground (or an object) in the world; Escape cancels

panel.text: While you control it, it makes no choices of its own: no rules, routine, reactions, AI decisions or hunting. It does what you say, then stands. Control ends when you press Release, leave the region, or after 10 minutes without a command.

check_box.name: rule_not
check_box.label: NOT: everyone except them
check_box.tool_tip: Turns the choice round: it reacts to everyone who is NOT this

button.label: Find people near
button.name: rule_people
button.tool_tip: List the people and NPCs within 96 m of you

button.label: Add
button.name: rule_add_action
button.tool_tip: Add this to what it does (up to 6)

panel.label: Scenes
panel.name: tab_scenes
panel.text: Ready-made scenes. You place each NPC yourself: stand where it should be and press Rez. AI talk is off in every scene.

button.label: Rez
button.name: scene_rez
button.tool_tip: It appears 2 m in front of you; its home is where you stand

button.label: Buy credits...
button.name: buy_btn
button.tool_tip: Opens the Wolf Credits page in your browser
